metrics.name: cpu_usage
metrics.description: The percentage of CPU usage by the application.

metrics.name: memory_usage
metrics.description: The amount of memory in megabytes currently being used by the application.

metrics.name: request_count
metrics.description: The total number of requests processed by the application.

metrics.name: average_response_time
metrics.description: The average time taken to process a request.

metrics.name: disk_io
metrics.description: The disk read and write speed in megabytes per second.

metrics.name: network_traffic
metrics.description: The incoming and outgoing network traffic in megabytes per second.

metrics.name: uptime
metrics.description: The total uptime of the application in seconds.

metrics.name: db_query_time
metrics.description: The average, maximum, and minimum time taken to execute database queries.

metrics.name: thread_count
metrics.description: The number of active threads in the application.

metrics.name: gc_activity
metrics.description: The number of garbage collection operations and the time taken for garbage collection.

metrics.name: cache_hit_ratio
metrics.description: The ratio of cache hits to total cache lookups.
